title: Disk space exhaustion on analytics-postgres persistent volume
description: The analytics-postgres data persistent volume is at 100% utilization: WAL segments and a runaway retention backlog filled the volume, PostgreSQL switched to read-only after failing to write, and inserts/autovacuum are failing. This is a storage-capacity failure on a stateful workload, not a compute or memory issue.
